Container.Name: Cody
Container.Overview: Cody — a self-hosted web workspace for coding agents. Session browsing, live chat, Git panel with staging and checkpoints, persistent terminals, workspace tasks, and an embedded app preview. The agent engine is swappable from the UI: omp (oh-my-pi) ships in the container, and Claude Code or Codex can be installed and selected as experimental engines. Point /workspace at your projects share and open the WebUI.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Agent state, checkpoints and shell home. Keep on appdata.

Config.Name: Projects
Config.Description: Your repositories — the workspaces Cody and the agent operate on.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Password for the built-in 'cody' account (sign-in and HTTP Basic Auth). Required on first start; once you have created your own account in Cody it may be removed.

Config.Name: Allow Account Signup
Config.Description: Leave empty (or 1) to allow creating new accounts from the login screen. Set to 0 to restrict account creation to administrators in Settings > User Accounts.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Optional: API key for the agent's model provider. Any provider env var omp understands can be added the same way.
